analysis: Portfolio snapshot: four positions (APP +7.2%, MSFT -1.4%, UBER +1.95%, V +1.6%) totaling ~$114K against $100K equity — we're already running modest margin (-$14K cash). Portfolio heat is low at 2.28%, but negative cash means any new position adds margin exposure. The macro backdrop remains a US-China trade-truce bounce; market sentiment has swung positive but many names are now extended (QCOM +45% above SMA50, TER +64% above SMA200 — hard avoids). Screened universe has 30 quality candidates, but most basing setups have SMA50 slopes still negative (ADP -2.4%, AMP -2.2%, RJF -1.5%), suggesting the base hasn't fully formed. The few genuine uptrend-basing candidates worth new capital: MCO stands out — oligopoly pricing power, 71% ROE, 45% operating margins, recovering in an uptrend at 32% of its 52-week range, just above SMA50 with slope turning positive. RJF (fwd P/E 11.5, PEG 0.97) is attractive on value but slope still declining — wait. Given we already carry 4 positions and negative cash, discipline says maximum one incremental addition. MCO qualifies as a high-conviction 5th position at modest size. Everything else (COIN, HOOD, PSKY) is either speculative or extended. Cash remains a large implicit position given margin; no forcing trades beyond one clear setup.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $448-452, ideally on a 1-2 day pullback to SMA50 or flat-base support. If no pullback within 5 sessions and price holds above $450, enter at market.

Fwd P/E of 24x is a fair price for this quality, especially 16% below 52-week high. TECHNICAL: Confirmed uptrend, basing pattern at 32% of 52-week range ($411-$538). Price sits just above SMA50 (+1%), SMA50 slope turned slightly positive (+0.4% over 20 days). ATR is a manageable 2.6%. This is a Stage 1→2 transition setup — not chasing, buying the base.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) price closes below stop $430 (thesis break / failed base); (2) credit market conditions deteriorate materially (spike in IG spreads, debt issuance freeze); (3) position reaches target ~$515 and momentum stalls — trail stop to breakeven; (4) 90-day time stop if price fails to make progress above SMA200 ($480). Consider holding past 1-year mark for LTCG treatment if thesis intact at month 11.
